title: Private Eye Atari 2600 Activision Arcade Game - Tested
descriptionText:
Private Eye for the Atari 2600, published by Activision. This is a genuinely scarce, sought-after cartridge among Atari collectors due to its low original production numbers -- not a common bargain-bin title.

With an E-Everyone rating, this game falls under the Arcade/Battle genres. Cartridge only, tested and working, ready for hours of retro gameplay on your Atari 2600 console.

NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region cartridge.

A must-have for serious Atari 2600 collectors looking to fill a gap in their Activision library.
